title: Make check-logic fixes fast: re-check a run without re-rendering (0.2s vs ~8 min)

log.text: Read the check code: picture-space judging is already applied where MediaPipe reads our cartoon reliably (torso_lean, hip_included). The remaining red is real arm-pose gaps (elbow/upperarm/width, judged on the rig because the detector can't read the cartoon's arms) and coach-side disagreements (knee flat-vs-3D) — not loose comparisons, so no picture-space sweep to do.

Measured the real loop cost: the check step (run_check.py) is 0.17s on the squat's existing measurements with no Blender; a full re-render is ~8 min. Every check-logic tweak currently pays the full render.

Added studio/scripts/recheck.mjs: re-runs only the check step against an already-rendered run, rewriting checks.json, no render, no Blender, no verdict-logic change. Verified in a throwaway data root — happy path, name + --run, three error paths, and the live run untouched. Whole tool 0.13s.

summary: recheck.mjs gives a 0.13s check-only loop (vs ~8 min) for fixing check rules. No exercises listed, so nothing re-renders from this item.
rerunNote: No exercises were listed, so nothing re-ran.
